title: User can't log in
presenterNote: The IAM/identity service behind the login journey goes down. Every 'customer can't log in' report is a symptom; the origin is one shared IAM route.
expectedOrigin: eis_iam_authenticate — the shared IAM/identity dependency behind login
decoy: a wall of failed logins (5151) across many users — looks like an app problem
description: The identity service (IAM) behind the login journey fails. Users pile up 'can't log in' errors on their phones, but the origin is the single shared IAM route on the EIS gateway — not the app.
